campaign_scope: Stored canonical execution7 STATE records across allocation workers and history; not current physical-worker partition totals and not live process counts
limitations: Raw model states, prediction arrays, data, installed runtimes, archives, generic logs and per-iteration JSONL are excluded at user request.
Historical Git commits and unchanged tracked files are inherited without rewriting.
Large derived planning dumps and geometry arrays encoded in JSON are excluded; compact scores, configurations and conclusions are selected.
